# authwise_access_bindings (Data Source)

A binding that grants a subject a role in an audience's Access catalog. This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `audience_id` (String) Parent identifier `audience_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `access_bindings` (Attributes List) Every access_binding under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_bindings))

<a id="nestedatt--access_bindings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_bindings`

Read-Only:

- `created_by` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.

- `role_name` (String)

- `subject_type` (String)
